description: Microsoft Edge (OS component on Windows Server 2022). Verify-only — no separate download.
verify: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$roots=@([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ProgramFiles'),[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ProgramFiles(x86)')) | Where-Object { $_ }; $edge=$roots | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_ 'Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe' } | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $edge){ throw 'missing' }; $true"
